title: Chubby Finn
desc: Chubby Finn is a friendly Sokoban-style puzzle about a seal who can push balls but never pull them. Walk through each layout carefully, avoid trapping a ball against a wall and place every target perfectly.
howto: Move Finn around the level with the arrow controls.
Push a ball into the correct target position.
Remember that balls cannot be pulled back.
Restart early if a ball gets wedged against a wall.
Solve every layout to complete the level set.
tips: Plan the order of pushes before moving the first ball.
Keep open space between balls until the route is clear.
